entities.name: Query viral gp160
observations: 768 aa viral envelope precursor with GP120 Pfam domain at residues 34–511 and GP41 Pfam domain at residues 531–721.
Homologous to curated SIV/HIV gp160 proteins with 64.2–74.0% identity and near-complete query coverage.
Predicted type I single-pass envelope glycoprotein architecture: large external gp120-like region, gp41 fusion/membrane anchor region, and short cytoplasmic tail.

Likely forms a trimeric Env spike and is processed into gp120 and gp41 by host furin-like protease; these functions are inferred from close curated homologs, not directly experimentally tested for this exact sequence.

entities.name: SIV/HIV gp160 homologs
observations: Curated reference envelope precursors P17281, Q1A243 and Q9IDV2 show gp120/gp41 organization, viral attachment, class I membrane fusion, trimerization, furin-like processing, and virion/host membrane localization.

entities.name: Retroviral entry and fusion
observations: Likely biological processes include virion attachment to host cells, receptor-triggered membrane fusion, viral protein processing, and delivery of the viral core after membrane fusion.
GO terms transferred from close homologs include viral envelope/virion membrane localization, structural molecule activity, virion attachment, and fusion with host plasma or endosomal membranes.
